description: Defines an interface for prime number tables and two implementations: on-the-fly calculation and pre-calculated primes, used in Google Test samples for parameterized testing.

classes.name: PrimeTable
classes.description: Interface for prime number tables with methods to check primality and get next prime.

classes.name: PreCalculatedPrimeTable
classes.description: Precomputes and stores prime numbers up to a maximum value.

methods.name: IsPrime
methods.description: Checks if a number is prime.

methods.name: GetNextPrime
methods.description: Returns the next prime greater than a given number.

methods.name: CalculatePrimesUpTo
methods.description: Precomputes prime numbers up to a specified maximum.
